# bizkit_mailing_list (Resource)

A mailing list. Contacts and their consent belong to one list. Needs an API key with `mailing:admin`. Destroying a list deletes its contacts, broadcasts and sequences.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bizkit_mailing_list" "newsletter" {
  project_id  = bizkit_project.website.id
  name        = "Newsletter"
  description = "Product news, about once a month."
  footer      = "Example Inc, 1 Main Street, Springfield"
  archive     = true
  form_ids    = [bizkit_form.contact.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name.
- `project_id` (String) The project it belongs to. Changing it replaces the list.

### Optional

- `archive` (Boolean) Whether the public archive shows broadcasts marked archived. Defaults to `false`.
- `description` (String) What subscribers get, for the team.
- `double_opt_in` (Boolean) API and admin adds must confirm by mail. Form captures always confirm. Defaults to `true`.
- `footer` (String) Text at the end of every mail, such as a postal address.
- `form_ids` (Set of String) Forms of the same project whose submissions with an email join the list.

### Read-Only

- `archive_url` (String) The public archive page, set even while the archive is off.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The list ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by ID.
tofu import bizkit_mailing_list.example <id>
```
